## What changed

The comment gate was counting the wrong lines and firing on the wrong edits.

- **Scoped to the edit region.** The gate judged the whole file rather than
  what the tool call actually added, so an edit near existing comments was
  blamed for them.
- **The gate and the reminder now count the same lines**, which they did not,
  so the two halves of one convention disagreed about whether a comment was
  prose.
- **The reminder is revived** — `PreToolUse` deny suppresses `PostToolUse`, so
  under the plugin the gate answers first, but the `lat init` wiring registers
  no `PreToolUse` at all and the reminder is the only enforcement there.
- **Structural delimiters in quoted body prose are neutralized**, so repository
  text cannot close the fence it was placed inside.
- **Graph edges land on real nodes**, and quoted paths survive rendering.
- The README warns that the two install routes shadow each other:
  `~/.local/lat/bin` is prepended to `PATH`, so a Release-route install hides a
  mise-managed one and `mise upgrade` then reports a version the shell never
  runs.
